paraphrase: In the unrestricted higher-order Scott/AFP embedding, an individual satisfies the formal predicate NE at a world if and only if that world has no distinct accessible successor. The forward direction uses the admissible property identifying that individual at exactly that world as an essence; the reverse direction uses the essence's actual exemplification. No positivity axiom, excluded middle or frame condition is required. This exposes the strength of full intensional-property quantification; it is not a theory-independent statement about metaphysical necessary existence.
